Thanks, noted. Let me know what you'd like to know about Acme's policies.
How many vacation days do new employees get?

In the first year, full-time employees receive 14 paid vacation days, and the allowance grows by one day per year of service up to 24. Part-time employees get a proportional amount. The full details are in the policy document in the HR portal.
Can I carry unused days over?
Yes, up to 5 unused days carry over to the next calendar year and expire on March 31. If your situation is unusual, write to hr@acme.example.
What are the office days?
Tuesday and Wednesday are office days for all teams; you can work remotely up to 2 days a week. If your situation is unusual, write to hr@acme.example.
How do I claim the home office allowance?
Acme gives a one-time 1,500 NIS allowance; claim it in the expense system within 60 days of the purchase. If your situation is unusual, write to hr@acme.example.
Who approves working from abroad?
Remote work from abroad needs written approval from your department's VP, up to 10 working days a year. Your manager can also help with the practical side.
What are core hours?
Be reachable on Slack between 10:00 and 16:00 Israel time. The full details are in the policy document in the HR portal.
How do vacation requests work?
Requests of 3 days or more go through the HR portal at least 2 weeks ahead, approved by your direct manager. The full details are in the policy document in the HR portal.
Is there a shutdown week?
Yes, between Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur; 3 vacation days are deducted automatically. If your situation is unusual, write to hr@acme.example.
